transcript.text: If you think about yourself as the hero
of your own story, what creates the
strength of the hero?
The obstacle.
The monster. The bigger the monster, the
bigger the hero. I used to tell myself
that this is going to be part of the
story I would tell. The many
disadvantages that you have become
advantages to the story that you have.
If you have those disadvantages to you,
you can become the hero of that story
and you become a bigger hero because of
the things that you had the opportunity
to overcome.
And so like that becomes the part of the
story that you can tell. And those
become the monsters that you slay and
also pave the path for everybody behind
you who doesn't think it's possible.
